qualifications: Chinese-taught Group A: TOCFL A2 or HSK level 4 minimum
English-taught tracks: e.g. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 82

description_short: International bachelor program at National Tsing Hua University's Tsing Hua College for Fall 2027. Applications run from October 1, 2026 to April 22, 2027 (12:00 noon Taiwan time); selection is mainly by document review, with a quota of 180 international students.
